enabled: HTTP(S) standalone CLI and scrape_websites callable
bounded parallel fetch and explicit retries
retained source bodies, spans, links and unreviewed contact candidates
local JSON/JSONL/Markdown output and offline consumption
limits: request-timeout is operation-wide including capture, not only per-request
chunked bodies may exceed byte cap by one charged transport chunk before typed failure
same-origin redirects only; cross-port denied even if separately admitted
proof consistency does not cryptographically authenticate remote origin
input_ref differs between typed outcome and URL-based proof; join through occurrence/key instead
storage_policy: LadybugDB mirrored to SQLite; standalone path requires neither; PostgreSQL is not a deployment target
